subject: Billing cadence, PO placement, and contract tiering — Valence procurement questions
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <s.lee@valencehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Valence Procurement <procure@valencehealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-02 08:05 AM PST
Subject: Questions on invoicing cadence & PO requirements

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited about the latency profiles and the caching features. Procurement has a few practical questions before we can issue a PO:

- We need an invoice cadence that matches our financial close: one consolidated invoice per month for all usage across our three regions (not per-project). Is that supported?
- Each invoice must include a PO number (we will issue a single blanket PO for the calendar year) and the PO number needs to be present on every invoice line.
- Our standard payment terms are payment within 45 days of invoice receipt (we call it payment within 45 days). Any exceptions need pre-approval.
- We require a W-9 and confirmation of Redwood’s legal entity for tax/contracting.

Two further items from sourcing: Valence prefers quarterly billing if possible (consolidated monthly is acceptable), and they evaluate discounts differently depending on whether it's an annual prepay vs month-to-month usage. Can you share what discount tiers Redwood offers for a 12-month vs a monthly commitment (for the committed usage band in the SOW)?

I’ve attached Valence’s PO template. Happy to set a short call if that would be easier to align.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Sr. Procurement Manager | Valence Health
procure@valencehealth.com
+1 415 555 0192

Attachment: Valence_PO_Template.pdf (stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <s.lee@valencehealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-02 10:18 AM PST
Subject: Re: Questions on invoicing cadence & PO requirements

Hi Samantha — great to hear from you and glad Valence found the demo useful. Quick answers below, and I’ve copied Grace from Sales Ops to confirm implementation details.

- Consolidated monthly invoice: yes, we can issue a single monthly invoice that aggregates usage across all projects/regions under the same account and references the blanket PO number.
- PO on invoice: we can include the PO number on every invoice line item; we’d need the exact PO number (and if there are multiple PO numbers for specific cost centers, please tell us which fields to populate).
- Payment terms: Redwood’s standard hosted offering defaults to net 30, but for enterprise customers we commonly accept payment within 45 days. We can commit to payment within 45 days for Valence under the Master Services Agreement (MSA) — I’ll flag this to Finance for record.
- W-9 and entity: attached is our current W-9 and the Redwood legal entity as requested (see MSA attachment).

Regarding discounts:
- Monthly (pay-as-you-go) usage: limited to promotional credits and volume-based tiering; typical effective discount is 0–7% depending on committed monthly throughput.
- 12-month committed spend (prepay or invoiced quarterly): we can offer a stronger commercial tier — for example, an 18% list discount on the committed band for an annual prepay, or 12% if invoiced quarterly with a signed SOW committing to the spend.

Grace — can you confirm the billing code and the exact invoice overlay (PO field + cost center field) so we can mirror Valence’s template? Also flagging to Kar t hik for any legal language we should accept around the invoice/PO requirement.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that helps finalize the PO flow.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0233

Attachment: Redwood_W-9.pdf (stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <s.lee@valencehealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-03 09:42 AM PST
Subject: Re: Questions on invoicing cadence & PO requirements

Hi Samantha — looping in Finance/Revenue Ops and Legal so we can map Valence’s PO fields cleanly into our billing system. A few operational notes: 

1) Invoice format: we can populate the PO number in the invoice header and repeat it on each line. We can also include an extra free-text field for your internal cost center if you provide it.
2) Billing cadence: our billing system supports both monthly and quarterly consolidated invoices. Please confirm whether you prefer strictly monthly consolidated invoices or quarterly (we can do either).
3) Net terms: Jordan mentioned Finance is okay with payment within 45 days. To operationalize that, we’ll mark your account as NET-45 in our billing system once the MSA is countersigned and a valid PO is on file.
4) Taxes/W-9: we provided our W-9; Kar t hik — please review any redline requests on Section 6 (invoicing and payment) of the MSA.

If Valence signs up for the annual committed band with prepay, Finance will also need the invoicing contact and the remit-to address for the prepayment check/ACH.

Proposed next steps:
- Samantha: confirm monthly vs quarterly consolidated invoice preference and provide the cost-center mapping (if needed).
- Valence Procurement: send the blanket PO number once approved.
- Jordan: attach the SOW and an example invoice template to the HubSpot deal.

Thanks — we’ll be ready to accept the PO and finalize terms once the items above are confirmed.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_Billing_Fields.xlsx (internal stub)

From: Samantha Lee <s.lee@valencehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-04 03:22 PM PST
Subject: Re: Questions on invoicing cadence & PO requirements

Thanks — quick answers from procurement/legal side after internal review: 

- We will issue a single blanket PO for FY26 that covers all Redwood usage across regions. PO will be provided to Redwood within 7 business days of countersigning the MSA.
- Invoice cadence: Valence prefers monthly consolidated invoices (one invoice per month for all usage).
- Payment terms: Valence confirms payment within 45 days of invoice receipt — our AP team needs the Net-45 confirmation in the MSA appendix.
- Discounts: our sourcing prefers the annual prepay model if the commercial delta is at least 15% vs month-to-month. The 18% annual prepay discount you cited is within the acceptable range; please include that in the SOW/quote so sourcing can sign off.
- Required docs: please send the signed W-9 (we received), the Redwood legal entity name (for our contract), and the MSA with the Net-45 amendment.

We’ll return the signed blanket PO and the remit-to details once the MSA with the Net-45 language and the SOW reflecting the 18% annual prepay discount are available. If you can get those docs to us by EOD Wednesday, we can route the PO the same week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I’ve attached our PO template again.

Samantha
Sr. Procurement Manager | Valence Health

Attachment: Valence_PO_Template.pdf (re-attached)
